reason: Retain the utility-run owner after separating traversal, bounded file scheduling, transport storage, admitted record formatting and literal execution at their actual lifetimes. Its 955 receiver lines and 32 methods implement one grep/rg invocation: mode configuration, ordered operand traversal, verified file search and mode-specific emission. The 26 fields describe that run rather than independent services. Workers copy immutable configuration while owning local status, roots and statistics; one reducer publishes output and revision pins. Splitting mode state into forwarding owners would obscure those dependencies. Focused ordering, concurrency, source-mapping, cancellation and aggregate-resource contracts support this measured ceiling.
